body:
I don't remember if we agreed to run it on the actual example. I thought the reasoning was that we should create a minimal example (e.g. no Google Fonts, no image header to speed up the page load). We could add these minimal examples in the [`e2e/` folder](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/6dc0b3a2b921687f0add0decb8d17dc9888a3b7b/e2e). It's indeed nice to be able to run the example in CodeSandbox (some people asked for it already).

WDYT?
